capabilities: hide files or folders via a right-click menu command
create attribute-selector rules that match multiple paths
toggle all hidden items at once with a ribbon button
hide matching entries from the bookmarks panel
save generated CSS as a snippet that survives disabling the plugin
disambiguation: It hides individual files and folders inside the file explorer, not the explorer panel itself.
extras: The bookmarks file-menu integration is marked experimental with known visual bugs; generated CSS can be kept as a snippet so hidden files stay hidden after uninstalling. Available in English and French, installable via BRAT.
intentEvidence: For years, I have used a snippet named Folder Hider that does basically this
motivation: The author used a hand-maintained CSS snippet (Folder Hider) that broke on renames, required exact paths, and could not be toggled per file, so they built a plugin to manage it.
problem: Hiding items in the explorer normally requires hand-written CSS snippets that break when files are renamed or moved and are hard to manage.

relations.evidence: If you are using the Simple colored folder plugin, you will notice some issues with the hidden folders

summary: Hides chosen files and folders from the file explorer and bookmarks panel by generating and managing CSS rules for you.
